name: Chess Club of Dallas
notes: The Dallas Chess Club is a vibrant community of chess enthusiasts nestled in the heart of Texas. With its welcoming atmosphere and diverse membership, it's a place where players of all ages and skill levels come together to share their love for the game. From friendly matches to intense tournaments, the club provides a platform for growth, learning, and camaraderie. The dedicated organizers and passionate members create an environment that fosters both competitive spirit and a genuine sense of belonging. Joining this club means not only honing your chess skills but also becoming part of a tight-knit community that celebrates the intellectual richness of the game.

name: Red Rooks
notes: Red Rooks Chess Club is an OTB club in St. George, Utah. If you want to play some in-person chess, we meet at the following days and times: Every Thursday from 4-7 PM at the Santa Clara Library. Saturdays at the Santa Clara Library: 1st Saturday of the Month: 3:00-5:30pm 2nd, 3rd, & 5th Saturdays: 2:30-5:30pm 4th Saturday: No meeting (possible online Club Tournament) We have plenty of sets and clocks! Our members have a wide range of skill-levels, all are welcome. Informal instruction may be provided. If you're interested, please also join our Facebook group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/redrookschess/ (Note that "Red Rooks" club on Chess.com located in St George, UT is just starting to play online chess matches. However, do not confuse our "Red Rooks" club with the fully virtual club/team named "Red Rooks Chess Club".)

name: Round Rock Public Library Chess Group
notes: Chess Club (All ages and adults) Would you like to learn how to play chess? Or are you looking for a better handle on the your tactics? Join the Round Rock Public Library’s C hess Club where you will learn and play “The Game of Kings.” REGISTRATION is not necessary we meet every other Sunday, and now we have a Thursday chess get together. Just show up ready to play and have fun! This class with progress from the basics to the more intermediate and advanced chess levels, and you will find many levels among our club members, so don’t be shy you will find your spot among the members.

name: Warrensville Heights Library Chess Club
notes: The Warrensville Heights Library Chess Club is open to all chess players. We are committed to introducing chess to all ages and improving players level of chess knowledge. We will provide instruction on the basics for new players and advanced lessons for all levels of players. Playing chess will improve visual memory, attention span, spatial-reasoning ability. Learning the game at an early age will also help improve sportsman ship, problem solving, logical thinking and creativity. Join us for live chess every Saturday at the library from 1 pm to 3 pm.
